standard-dialogue-if-the-player-hasn-t-c.npc: I am offering a cart ride to Brimhaven, if you're interested. It will cost [amount] coins. Is that okay?

options.text: Yes please, I'd like to go to Brimhaven.

steps.player: Yes please, I'd like to go to Brimhaven.

steps.text: If the player has enough coins:

You hop into the cart and the driver urges the horses on. You take a taxing journey through the jungle to Brimhaven. You feel tired from the journey, but at least you didn't have to walk all that distance.
If the player doesn't have enough coins:

steps.npc: Sorry, but it looks as if you don't have enough money. Come and see me when you have enough for the ride.
Okay, Bwana, let me know if you change your mind.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-comp.npc: I am offering a cart ride to Brimhaven, if you're interested. For you, it's free.

talking-to-vigroy-before-completing-shil.speaker: Note
talking-to-vigroy-before-completing-shil.text: This is not typically possible, because accessing Vigroy requires completion of Shilo Village.

talking-to-vigroy-before-completing-shil.npc: Sorry, I'm busy. I've got to get out of here! This place is swarming with zombies.
